No information is available on the use of micafungin during breastfeeding. Because micafungin is more than 99% bound to plasma proteins and has poor oral bioavailability, it is unlikely to reach the milk and be absorbed by the infant. Micafungin can safely be given intravenously to infants under 4 months of age. Any amount absorbed from milk is likely to be far less than an infant dose. If a mother requires micafungin, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding.
